Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you are the driver of the vehicle involved
in the parking lot collision in Pearland?
A: Yes, that's right. I was driving my own car.
Q: Please describe where you were when the collision happened.
A: I was in the parking lot of a shopping center, heading toward an open space near the main entrance. It was a busy
afternoon, so there were a lot of cars moving around.
Q: What happened next?
A: Another vehicle backed out of a space on my left without really looking. I tapped the brakes, but the front of my car
still hit the rear quarter panel of their SUV. It wasn't a high-speed impact, but it was enough to jolt me forward and
then back against the seat.
Q: Did you have any immediate physical reaction?
A: My right knee hit the dashboard area. At first I thought it was just bruised, but by the evening it was swollen and
painful to bend. I had trouble putting weight on it the next morning.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the following day. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic
provider. I have an appointment scheduled, and I'm using crutches for now.
Q: Were the police or any other parties involved at the scene?
A: An officer came and took a report. The other driver was there and exchanged insurance information with me. I also
took photos of both cars before they were moved.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still havnig pain and I'm trying to keep my records together. I'll send you copies of the clinic bills and
the photos when I get home.
Q: Thnak you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
